podcast.body: Achieving a top 20 position, "Panama" was another of Van Halen's successful singles from 1984. Along with "I'll Wait" and a massive number one hit, it helped solidify the band's album "1984" as a commercial and critical success in hard rock. "Van Halen scored three top 20 hits in 1984, including Isle Wait and Panama."

podcast.body: Played "many, many, many" times by the US Army during Operation Just Cause in December 1989. The song was part of a loud music bombardment directed at the Vatican Embassy in Panama City to force out Manuel Noriega, the Panamanian dictator. "Well refugee from Competty wanted dead or alive by Bon Jovi and many many many plays of Van Halen's Panama."
